data_fields.name: cheat_rate_bypass
data_fields.donor_constant: allowMulti false on the cheat path

best_idea: Store XP as the one number per skill, derive the level from a fixed threshold table, and on level-up give back exactly the levels gained to a drained (debuffed) current level instead of resetting it.
decision_why: Keep the XP-to-level derivation and the drained-level replenish rule for fight debuffs, but put the curve in one engine constant and the sketch keeps the donor's x10 stored encoding for fidelity; Frankendom may store whole XP instead unless the HUD needs tenths (then award amounts must be divided by 10 to match the thresholds).
acceptance: A server test where XP crossing a threshold raises the level by exactly one per threshold crossed (level 2 at 83 XP, level 3 at 174 XP under this curve), and a fight-drained stat one level below base rises by the number of levels gained rather than snapping to base.
